verdict.rationale: Visa publishes the Trusted Agent Protocol spec openly. It is built on RFC 9421, defines required signature fields, tags, and timestamp/nonce rules, and ships a reference implementation with a cdn-proxy verifier and signature-base snippets. A sandbox accepts test transactions. The Intelligent Commerce REST API is path-versioned (/acp/v1/...) with documented required fields, but the product carries an 'in development' caveat, and there is no dedicated conformance suite or machine-readable schema. Missing for 10: formal machine-readable schema (e.g. OpenAPI/JSON Schema), an explicit protocol versioning policy for TAP, a dedicated conformance/validation test suite, and independent hands-on corroboration.
